name: @hotelos-apps/jobs-ui
description: Jobs' packaged desktop module — the board, a job, raising, resolving, the live tab, the catalogue and the settings.

scripts.build: npm run build:module && npm run build:widgets
scripts.build:widgets: node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/jobs-now.js widgets/entry/jobs-now.ts && node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/the-board.js widgets/entry/the-board.ts && node ../../scripts/build-module.mjs widgets/blocked.js widgets/entry/blocked.ts
